elements.label: Intelligence Clue
elements.description: Intelligence Clue

elements.label: Enemy Intelligence Network (Retired)
elements.description:
Perhaps because the front line has been pushed too far, or perhaps the evil seeds they planted have taken effect; the enemy no longer values intelligence.
[The enemy intelligence agency will never bother you again]

elements.label: Enemy Intelligence Network (Silent)
elements.description:
We have finally uprooted this 'filth' from the military, but that does not mean we can let our guard down. They are ready to make a comeback at any time.
[While this card is present, enemy intelligence agencies will no longer appear]

elements.label: Enemy Intelligence Network (Destroyed)
elements.description:
We have finally uprooted this 'filth' from the military, but that does not mean we can let our guard down. They are ready to make a comeback at any time.
[While this card is present, enemy intelligence agencies will not appear locally]

elements.label: Intelligence Clue
elements.description:
They took or destroyed almost all the documents when they withdrew, but there are always some things they cannot take away.
[When you have seven clues, you can attempt to eradicate the enemy intelligence agency]

elements.label: Secondary Objective: Eradicate Intelligence Organization
elements.description: Find a rat nest, should burn it now. [This will free you from the interference of the intelligence agency for a period of time]

elements.label: Jealousy of the Red Grail
elements.description: Desire breeds, flesh grows. I can feel something squirming under my skin, an unceasing itch.

elements.label: Threshold: Grail and Moth
elements.description: If I wanted to deal with this threat using Grail and Moth, I would need this much of both - but perhaps there are other strategies to consider.

elements.label: Secondary Objective: Steal the cipher
elements.description:
Our spies have brought back detailed information on the cipher storage location and the enemy's radio station. It is time to regain the initiative in intelligence.
[Completing this mission will reduce the enemy's decryption progress by 1-3 points and provide a small intelligence advantage]

elements.label: Secondary Objective: Suppress the resistance
elements.description:
Every informant will have their throat seized, every whisper will be drowned out by gunfire.
[Completing this mission will reduce the enemy's resistance progress by 1-3 points and provide a small amount of provisions]

elements.label: Secondary Objective: Counter-infiltration
elements.description:
Our spies have brought back detailed information on infiltration zones and enemy agent identities. Use spies against spies, reverse the tracking.
[Completing this mission will reduce the enemy's infiltration progress by 1-3 points and provide 'Opportunities' or 'Secondary Objectives']

elements.label: Infamy
elements.description: We told them it was all for the final victory, but saying that too often grows tiresome; now they trust more in the bread in their own hands. [When infamy accumulates to three, local dissent will be triggered inevitably.]

elements.label: Conflict Level
elements.description:
The unreasonable demands of the local populace.
[When this card reaches three stacks, it will injure all friendly forces in the operation.]

elements.label: Insight
elements.description:
The enemy has now obtained intelligence on our movements, allowing them to coordinate more flexibly.
[Enemy units with this aspect cannot be attacked using overwhelming tactics.]

elements.label: Guardian
elements.description:
The enemy now knows our next mission objective, and they will not sit idly by.
[This task must overcome an extra random challenge upon initiation.]

elements.label: Vanguard
elements.description: [This is the first spy you sent, and they will return first as well]

elements.label: notmoreprovisions
elements.comments: 这是为了让当地人好好做事的

elements.label: Enemy Gestapo?
elements.description: The enemy's intelligence agency laid a dragnet in this region before the war even began. Once their eyes are on you, death is only a matter of time.

elements.label: Enemy Gestapo
elements.description: The enemy's intelligence agency laid a dragnet in this region before the war even began. Once their eyes are on you, death is only a matter of time.

elements.label: Infiltration Level
elements.description:
First a farmer, then a soldier, then an officer at headquarters, and finally my personal guard.
[As the level increases, enemy actions become increasingly threatening. Maximum level is 10, which can directly attack you and your allies. If infiltration reaches zero, the local intelligence agency will be destroyed. When infiltration is high, you can use special means in 'Communicate' to reduce it.]

elements.label: Decryption Level
elements.description: War is ninety percent intelligence. — Napoleon Bonaparte [As the level increases, enemy actions become increasingly threatening. Maximum level is 10, which grants the enemy an intelligence advantage bonus.]

elements.label: Resistance Level
elements.description:
There are quite a few Ukrainians, Belarusians, Russians—all the dregs of the old Russian Empire who see the German invasion as a 'liberation.' Local resistance sentiment grows by the day...
[As the level increases, enemy actions become increasingly threatening. Maximum level is 10, which will trigger a local rebellion organized by the populace.]

elements.label: Enemy Intention
elements.description: The enemy's secret police and spies prowl the rear like hyenas.

elements.label: Enemy Intention
elements.description: The enemy's secret police and spies prowl the rear like hyenas.

elements.label: Preparations Ongoing
elements.description:
The enemy is preparing another course of action.
[The enemy needs three layers of preparations to launch another action.]

elements.label: Preparations Thwarted!
elements.description:
Our spy has sabotaged a link in the enemy's preparations.
[The enemy has lost one layer of preparations due to your sabotage.]

elements.label: The Enemy Intelligence Agency's Plan
elements.description: The enemy is planning their next move against us. If we send a spy, we might be able to discover some of their intentions.

elements.label: The Enemy Intelligence Agency's Plan
elements.description: The enemy is planning their next move against us. If we send a spy, we might be able to discover some of their intentions.

elements.label: The Enemy Intelligence Agency's Plan
elements.description: The enemy is planning their next move against us. If we send a spy, we might be able to discover some of their intentions.

elements.label: The Enemy Intelligence Agency's Plan
elements.description: The enemy is planning their next move against us. If we send a spy, we might be able to discover some of their intentions.

elements.label: Enemy Plan Revealed: Infiltration
elements.description:
Our enemy intends to expand their intelligence network this time.
[You need to use <sprite name=edge> and <sprite name=heart> to sabotage this plan.]

elements.label: Enemy Plan Revealed: Resistance
elements.description:
Our enemy intends to fund local resistance forces this time.
[You need to use <sprite name=winter> and <sprite name=grail> to sabotage this plan.]

elements.label: Enemy Plan Revealed: Decryption
elements.description:
Our enemy will focus on decrypting our intelligence this time.
[You need to use <sprite name=forge> and <sprite name=moth> to sabotage this plan.]

elements.label: Enemy Plan Revealed: Respite
elements.description: Our enemy will not take action against us this time. They will rest... and perhaps in resting, they will grow stronger.

elements.label: Infiltration Upgrade
elements.description:
Our enemy is taking us more seriously and investing more resources.
[The enemy intelligence agency's infiltration level will increase]

elements.label: Decryption Upgrade
elements.description:
Our enemy is taking us more seriously and investing more resources.
[The enemy intelligence agency's decryption level will increase]

elements.label: Resistance Upgrade
elements.description:
Our enemy is taking us more seriously and investing more resources.
[The enemy intelligence agency's resistance level will increase]

elements.label: Enemy Intelligence Agency Weakness: Unknown
elements.description:
We need more intelligence to find their weakness.
[By placing the corresponding 'Opportunity' when the intelligence agency grows, you can identify the agency's weakness. Each region's intelligence agency has a different weakness. Placing the corresponding 'Opportunity' can stop the local agency's growth and may provide a 'Secondary Objective' to undermine their infiltration efforts.]

elements.label: Enemy Intelligence Agency Weakness: Known
elements.description:
We have identified their weakness.
[Each region's intelligence agency has a different weakness. Placing the corresponding 'Opportunity' can stop the local agency's growth and may provide a 'Secondary Objective' to undermine their infiltration efforts.]

elements.label: Enemy Intelligence Agency Weakness
elements.description:
We have identified their weakness.
[Each region's intelligence agency has a different weakness. Placing the corresponding 'Opportunity' can stop the local agency's growth and may provide a 'Secondary Objective' to undermine their infiltration efforts.]

elements.label: Weakness: Heights
elements.description: High places are safe from ground-level observation, but not from snipers and traps.

elements.label: Weakness: Ruins
elements.description: Tall buildings are like forests, ruins like bushes—yet no matter where, the hound can still catch the hare.

elements.label: Weakness: Sewers
elements.description: They hide in the sewers like rats. Fortunately, we have plenty of  rat traps.

elements.label: Weakness: Dove
elements.description: The white dove—symbol of peace, image of the The Elegist, a sharp and mad little bird—makes our enemies tremble.

elements.label: Weakness: Cats
elements.description: Cats—furry little killers, the Lionsmith's smallest creation, carriers of ten thousand allergens—stop our enemies in their tracks.

elements.label: Weakness: Wolves
elements.description: Wolves—deadly hunting packs, image of the god of destruction, metaphor for despair and death—are what our enemies absolutely refuse to approach.

elements.label: Weakness: Velvet
elements.description: Velvet buries secrets deep. The enemy dares not touch her black hem.

elements.label: Weakness: Madrugad
elements.description: The Madrugad brings balance. The enemy fears her cold dawn.

elements.label: Weakness: Beachcomber
elements.description: The Beachcomber knows lost things. The enemy fears their secrets being stolen.
